Logo as the accessible name for a home link
examples.description: No aria-label on the parent link - Logo itself provides the accessible name.

antiExamples.name: Double accessible name
antiExamples.reason: Both the link and the Logo expose an accessible name here, so a screen reader announces "LegacyHQ home, LegacyHQ" - mark the Logo decorative when the parent link already has aria-label.

antiExamples.name: Recoloring the artwork
antiExamples.reason: Logo renders the approved SVG as-is - there is no supported way to recolor, stretch, or add effects to it.

antiExamples.name: Recreating the wordmark in text
antiExamples.reason: Use type="wordmark" or type="full" instead of typing the brand name - the approved artwork is the only correct rendering.
